newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL noon rubber up, trade cautious ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: KL noon rubber up, trade cautious ahead of weekend.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were higher at noon on Friday but activity was sluggish after a holiday and ahead of the weekend, traders said.
"Being Friday, I don't think there's going to be anything substantial, " said a trader.
"People usually don't like to take positions ahead of a weekend and the ringgit is still a concern for many," added the trader.
The ringgit has fallen by more than 600 points against the U.S. dollar in the last week.
Although this made Malaysian rubber more competitive against Thai and Indonesian, the fall was too fast for the market to grasp, said the traders.

At midday, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board (MRELB) quoted the benchmark RSS1 buyer for August at 235 cents (90 U.S. cents) a kg, up 2.50 cents from Wednesday's close. The SMR20 buyer for August was up half cent to 236.50.
The market was closed on Thursday for a religious holiday.
Traders quoted Wednesday price levels, putting the SMR 20 at 241 cents, SMR CV at 295, SMR L at 277, SMR5 at 248, SMR10 at 242 and drum latex at 193.
